topic: Wiring practices and types of inspections
syllabus_extract: Wiring practices and types of inspections

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of wiring diagrams and identification of EWIS components; Safety: Ensure no live circuits are touched; Supervision: Instructor verifies diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: Why is proper wiring practice critical for aircraft safety?
List three common types of electrical inspections.

development.content:
Definition and scope of EWIS
Components of EWIS systems
Importance of EWIS maintenance
Regulatory requirements for EWIS
Consequences of EWIS failure

Standard wiring practices
Cable routing and support
Termination and connection standards
Insulation and protection methods
Labeling and documentation rules

Types of electrical inspections
Visual inspection criteria
Non-destructive testing methods
Inspection frequency and records
Defect reporting procedures

summary_questions: Explain the primary purpose of EWIS inspections.
Describe one standard practice for cable routing in aircraft wiring.
Identify two types of defects that require immediate reporting in EWIS.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief summary of the wiring practices covered in this lesson and relate them to the troubleshooting procedures discussed in LP 02.
